## Lecture outline

::: {.lec-outline}
::: {.lec-group}
### Fuzzy concepts

- Conventional versus fuzzy controllers
- Classical sets versus fuzzy sets
- Fuzzy membership graphs using cold, warm, and hot examples
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Fuzzy inference system

- Construction of a fuzzy inference system
- Fuzzification
- Fuzzy rule evaluation
- Defuzzification
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Operators and system types

- Min-max fuzzy logic operators
- Defuzzification methods
- Mamdani versus Sugeno fuzzy inference systems
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Implementation

- MATLAB Fuzzy Logic Toolbox implementation
:::

:::
